opening.argument: The video is identified as a 2017 clip premiere, with authorship and artist information that fits ordinary music promotion. The description provides standard distribution routes through iTunes and Google Play, naming the artist as “L-jane (aka. Isaiah) on social networks,” and gives a concert-organization contact rather than presenting an unusual payment or data request. It also identifies the creative author: “Words and music: Alexander Panasyuk.” Taken together, the premiere framing, named artist, download services, social pages, concert contact, and producer credit establish a conventional music release and promotional context.
